about: Blinded sitting of CONSTRUCTION flips on lettering logos, every design drawn at the professional's own width and garment (population A, read beside the pro's DST) or at a stated size (population B, Commons lettering, cost figures only). Pre-registered; nothing here was rendered or measured when it was committed. Supersedes the unsat wok42-1013 kit.
base_note: Today's main defaults, no overrides. Every arm turns ONE flag that is ON today to OFF.

corner_fold_off.variable: construction at an L corner: the pro folds one column round it; OFF butts two columns (flag ON today)
corner_fold_off.basis: Memory column-corner-folds-2026-10-23: the pro folds one column round every L corner (57 read), cuts only T junctions. ON since 2026-10-23 on numbers against the pro, not on Kent's eye.

italic_lean_off.variable: construction on slanted bars: columns cross along the slant; OFF crosses square to the piece axis (ON today)
italic_lean_off.basis: Memory italic-bars-2026-10-25; ON 2026-10-27 (hat 0.31 to 0.46 against the pro's 0.54).

text_lean_off.variable: construction in big letters (10 mm and up): diagonals cross like stems; OFF crosses square (ON today)
text_lean_off.basis: Memory lettering-10mm-up-band-2026-10-23; the pro crosses diagonals like stems. Only letters 10 mm and up can differ.

inside_stagger_off.variable: where cuts land at a pivot: inside ends staggered to 20 percent depth; OFF piles the full ends in one hole (ON today)
inside_stagger_off.basis: Memory inside-stagger-2026-10-23: the pro alternates; ours piled the full ends (16 to 79 against 2 to 5).

script_strokes_off.variable: construction of script: one column per pen stroke along the ink; OFF sews script as ordinary letters (ON today)
script_strokes_off.basis: Memory script-strokes-2026-10-26; ON by Kent 2026-10-26. Only script lettering can differ.

fold_slivers_off.variable: construction of an outlined letter: keyline slivers folded into their neighbour; OFF sews each as its own piece (ON today)
fold_slivers_off.basis: Memory mfab-recipe-trims-2026-10-26: the cuts were keyline slivers behind a dark hairline (hat 41 to 27). Only outlined art can differ.

lane_off.variable: construction, whole: the Column lane OFF, lettering back on the pre-lane skeleton satin tier (ON today)
lane_off.basis: Kent took the lane's side on 5 of 6 columns-flip pairs and flipped it ON 2026-10-12. The whole-construction arm: what the seven flags above are the parts of.

exit_next_off.variable: TRIMS ONLY (the control): the Euler walk no longer ends toward the next letter; reverts a shipped ON flag
exit_next_off.basis: wok42's reserve of the same name: trims up, flow and length held. The one arm built so the trim family has pairs it should win; if cuts, hops and needle-up mm do not track his pick HERE they cannot be read anywhere else.

manipulation.rule: An arm passes when it changes the stitch stream on at least `min_live_logos` logos and, on at least half of the logos it changes, every `moves` metric moves the stated way by its threshold and every `holds` metric moves by less than it. A byte-identical logo is not a pair. There are no reserves: a failing arm stays in the sitting flagged passes=false (Amendment 2 of wok42), and the analysis reads the leads on all live pairs and on the passing arms alone.

primary.why: #847's one lead independent of trims (+0.16 ties in, one sitting's)
#847's reversed hypothesis, direction written down in advance: he picks FEWER long stitches
his notes say denser is better; #847 found no support
the control: the one instrument that cleared chance in #842 and #847; if it does not replicate here nothing else in this sitting is read

analysis.ci: percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 20261011, over pairs AND over designs (the `design` key of each logo)
analysis.reading_rule: both intervals clear of zero and at least 10 pairs where Kent chose a side; otherwise 'no evidence either way' or 'n too small'
analysis.population: live pairs (arm differs from base). Identical and repeat pairs are controls and enter no agreement statistic.

pro_distance.population: A: the live pairs on the pro_baseline.JOBS logos
pro_distance.reading: distance = |ours - pro| (pro_pooled.distance), lower is closer, beside the same figures as a plain cost; kappa, both intervals (pairs and designs), n; pairs scoring his pick farther from the pro are counted
pro_distance.readers: pro_pair.pro_counts and pro_baseline.needle_up on ours.dst (designs/<logo>__<arm>.dst) and on the pro's DST, the same code on both
